notes: Identity verified from supplied text: title Perceived partner responsiveness promotes intellectual humility; Harry T. Reis, Karisa Y. Lee, Stephanie D. O'Keefe, Margaret S. Clark; Journal of Experimental Social Psychology 79 (2018) 21–33; DOI 10.1016/j.jesp.2018.05.006. Primary empirical journal report with Study 5 methods/results, not an abstract or secondary account. No local PDF assigned; no acquisition/rendering performed. Unassigned sides/fields are placeholders only. No mediation model or indirect effect is reported in Study 5. Candidate mood covariate effect F(1,468) = 1.75, p = .187, eta2 = 0.004; candidate condition effect controlling mood F(2,468) = 7.11, p = .001, eta2 = 0.029. Neither selected as a mediation effect. Study-wide final N = 520 is not established as adjusted-model analytic N. No N inferred from df. Overall exclusions: 232 of 752 starters removed, overlapping reasons: 230 attention check, 5 blank manipulation items, 2 skipped more than half the trials, 1 invariant response. Thirty-one missing gender reports concern the factorial model and do not establish mood-model missingness.
